covariance.label: conditional_local_pose_covariance
covariance.retraction: Delta(dt,Rodrigues(dr)) @ T_CW; camera-side translation; not exact SE3 exponential
covariance.conditional_on: fixed calibration, fixed final map, assumed pixel noise, selected pose mode
covariance.approximation: inverse robust-weighted local information; per-coordinate rho-prime weights; not sandwich/posterior
covariance.excluded: calibration/map error, correlation, gross mismatch and multiple planar modes

reproducibility: seeded sequential replay; not bitwise across versions/backends
recording: HFYU lossless input AVI; MJPG annotation; JSONL acquisition times authoritative
